title: Pi Hindsight configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-hindsight extension. Both `hindsight.json` and `hindsight.jsonc` are read, and comments and trailing commas are accepted in either.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema. Safe to delete.

setupComplete.description: When true, automatic memory network I/O is allowed.

mode.description: domain-tagged: shared coding bank plus project tags. isolated-bank: path-derived or dedicated bank per repo.

projectId.description: Explicit project id pin. Written as the tag project:<slug>.

projectIdStrategy.description: How the project id is derived when projectId is unset: remote = git origin URL, basename = git root folder name.

includeSharedObservations.description: When true, project recall ORs exact untagged (shared) observations with the project tag filter. Not cross-bank.

userScopeTags.description: User/life bank recall tags (any_strict). Empty array means no tag filter.

apiKey.description: Either a SecretRef object ({ source: "env", name: "VAR" }) or a literal key string. Prefer the env form.

banks.description: Ordered bank list. Layers merge by `id`; a new id appends to the tail.

banksFallback.description: Bank ids used when the decision model fails or returns unusable output. Replaced wholesale per layer.

decision.description: Model-driven recall-inject gate and bank routing.

enabled.description: When false the layer decides nothing and the memory paths keep their own bank selection.

model.description: role:<name> on a host that has model roles, or <provider>/<modelId> on every host. A role spec on a host without roles falls back to the session model.

maxTokens.description: Answer budget for backends that accept one. Values <= 0 mean no cap, and the field is left off the backend call.

timeoutMs.description: Per-attempt budget in milliseconds. Values <= 0 arm no timer, so only the caller's own signal can stop the call.

maxContextChars.description: Character budget for the recent-activity part of the prompt. When unset, the budget is derived from the resolved model's context window.

threshold.description: Probability at or above which a backend's numeric answer counts as yes. Default 0.5. Local models and cloud deciders calibrate differently, so tune this when you swap judge models.

instructions.description: Question text for the three gates. Tune this first when you change judge models; the defaults are written to say what each gate controls, which state fields matter, and which way to lean on an ambiguous turn.

inject.description: Gate A: whether this turn injects recall. No placeholders.

read.description: Gate B read: whether recall reads one bank. Placeholders: {bank}, {description}, {access}.

write.description: Gate B write: whether retain writes to one bank. Placeholders: {bank}, {description}, {access}.

systemOne.description: System One transport for the decision gates. Off by default, so the default config makes no request this layer does not already make.

enabled.description: When true, one ladder rung calls the gateway's System One endpoint directly instead of a host chat or judgment surface. Use it on pi, whose registry resolves chat models only.

baseUrl.description: Gateway base URL. The rung posts to <baseUrl>/v1/systemone. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3425.

model.description: Decision model the gateway serves over System One. Defaults to group/decider.

apiKeyEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the gateway key. The key itself is never stored in this config.

profiles.description: Per-subagent overrides. Read only from hindsight-subagent.json/.jsonc; the main session never loads that file. Each key is an omp subagent definition name and its value is a patch of this same config shape.

id.description: Stable unique key. Layers merge by id; tools and the decision model reference it. Defaults to alias.

alias.description: Keeps the coding / life role semantics (tags, derive, shared observations). Implied by a reserved id, and supplies a missing id.

bankId.description: Concrete Hindsight bank. Required for alias "user"; optional for coding entries.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. false disables the bank from any layer.

access.description: Defaults to read-write. Read paths skip write entries; write paths skip read entries.

derive.description: Only read on a coding entry (project role): how the bank name is derived. Ignored elsewhere.

description.description: What this bank holds, in plain terms. Shown to the decision model when it picks banks. Do not write access or write policy here — express those with `access` and `retain.mode`; a description that carries policy text measurably degrades bank selection.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. false keeps the entry out of automatic writes entirely.

mode.description: always writes on every retain turn, decision asks the decision model, explicit-only never writes automatically. Defaults to always on the coding-role entry and explicit-only on every other entry.

tagGroups.description: Explicit Hindsight tag groups; replaces derived tags for that entry.
